title: Does not support other apps.
body: The idea is there but if you have siri, you might as well use it instead. I asked the app to set an alarm, it did not show on my calendar. The interface is clean, too clean that i find it hard to check if it even understood the specific details of the plan i was telling it.

title: Bring back the collapsible subtasks
body: I dont like the update at all. I still have to tap on the maintask just to see and update the subtasks. Id like to see everything in one glance.
author: Bee585

title: Annoying
body: Although i love the idea of having suggested tasks for the day, i hate that Every two taps is a promotion for premium. This app is supposed to help people (especially ones neurodivergent) not prioritize monetization.
